# Reverb Academy

> Reverb Academy is a music academy in Mohali, Punjab, offering structured guitar, ukulele, piano and violin lessons.

## Learning formats
- In-person classes at two Mohali academies
- Home music tuition across Chandigarh Tricity, subject to availability
- Live one-to-one online music lessons

## Locations
- Sector 69: 1st Floor, Sovo International School, Sector 69, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160062
- Sector 113: 45C, 3rd Floor, Bollywood Green City, Sector 113, Mohali, Punjab
